support_claim: The billing record names Vellum Print Co Ltd as billed party and the SOW-VEL-2022 header names Vellum Print Co Ltd as counterparty, but neither observation provides establishing identity evidence beyond shared naming.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires evidence that establishes identity and name similarity is explicitly insufficient; the packet cites only matching names across billing and contract sources with no registration, cross-reference, or other identity anchor, and no evidence establishes distinctness, so neither burden is met.
